body:
#### PR description:

- Changed name of Worker to TransitionWorker*
- Each TransitionWorker template is specialized for its transition. Each specialization only has methods specific to its transition.
- Moved function definitions from header to source.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles. Framework unit tests pass.

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2413
title: Specialize workers for each transition type
